parameters.jsCode: const clean=v=>String(v||'').trim(),i=$json;const project_id=clean(i.project_id),episode_id=clean(i.episode_id),editing_template_version_id=clean(i.editing_template_version_id||'etv_system_urban_power_v1'),template_scope=clean(i.template_scope||'episode'),actor=clean(i.actor||'phase5-workflow');if(!project_id||!episode_id)throw new Error('INVALID_INPUT: project_id and episode_id are required');if(!['project','episode'].includes(template_scope))throw new Error('INVALID_INPUT: template_scope');return [{json:{...i,project_id,episode_id,editing_template_version_id,template_scope,actor,trace_id:clean(i.trace_id||('trace_phase17_'+require('crypto').randomUUID())),generation_version:Math.max(1,Number(i.generation_version||1)),dialogue_timings:Array.isArray(i.dialogue_timings)?i.dialogue_timings:[]}}];

const r=$input.first().json,snapshot=r.effective_context?.production_snapshot;if(!snapshot||snapshot.state!=='resolved'||!snapshot.payload)throw new Error('EFFECTIVE_INPUT_SNAPSHOT_REQUIRED: resolver did not freeze a resolved production snapshot');const p=snapshot.payload;return[{json:{...r,production_snapshot:p,lifecycle_inputs:p.lifecycle_inputs||{},entity_version_overlays:p.entity_version_overlays||{},effective_snapshot_binding_id:snapshot.binding_id,effective_snapshot_version_id:snapshot.version_id,effective_snapshot_hash:snapshot.content_hash,effective_snapshot_provenance:snapshot.provenance||[]}}];

parameters.jsCode: const n=$('Normalize Versioned Request').item.json;return [{json:{success:true,stage:'post_production_creative_workbench',workflow_contract:'creative-workbench',project_id:n.project_id,episode_id:n.episode_id,dialogue_timing_report:$('Validate Dialogue Timing Preview').item.json.data?.report||null,change_plan:$json.change_plan_response?.data||$json.change_plan_response,requires_user_confirmation:true,effective_input_provenance:$json.effective_input_provenance,effective_input_context:$('Enforce Effective Inputs').first().json.effective_context,incremental_only:true,history_preserved:true}}];

const request=$('Normalize Versioned Request').first().json,resolution=$json.effective_inputs;if(!resolution?.allowed){const error=new Error('EFFECTIVE_INPUTS_BLOCKED: '+JSON.stringify({resolution_id:resolution?.resolution_id,status:resolution?.status,missing:resolution?.missing||[],blockers:resolution?.blockers||[]}));error.name='EFFECTIVE_INPUTS_BLOCKED';throw error;}const effective_context=resolution.context||{};return [{json:{...request,effective_inputs:resolution,effective_context,payload:{...(request.payload||{}),effective_inputs:{resolution_id:resolution.resolution_id,context_hash:resolution.context_hash,resolution_hash:resolution.resolution_hash,context:effective_context}}}}];
